evals.prompt: shrink our python image, it's huge
evals.expected_output: Switches to a slim or distroless base rather than scratch (unless the binary is fully static), chains RUN commands so cleanup happens in the same layer it's created, prunes dev dependencies via a production install flag or multi-stage copy, and measures the result with dive or docker history instead of guessing.

evals.prompt: we deleted the apt cache in a later RUN but the image size didn't change
evals.expected_output: Explains that deleting files in a later layer does not reclaim the space earlier layers took, since layers are additive and immutable, and recommends chaining apt-get install and rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* in the same RUN so temporary files never persist as their own layer.

evals.prompt: arm64 support is annoying, let's just keep a separate Dockerfile.arm64
evals.expected_output: Pushes back on maintaining parallel Dockerfiles and recommends a single manifest list built with docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64, while flagging that any base image or dependency publishing only one architecture will surface as a build failure rather than a warning.
